name: Five Nights at F**kboys: Ennard's Valiant Expedition
summary:
Ennard embarks on a one-of-a-kind expedition...

Welcome to EVE, an original spin-off of the infamous Sister Location FNAFB game by Sivelos

Featuring perhaps over an hour or two of gameplay (idk for sure though tbh could be less), it has more than enough to satiate you fnafb gamers.

Originally developed by Ashy202 & AxelLino126

Ennard must embark on a quest to root out the true cause of all the events that transpire. Will Ennard and his new allies be able to identify and solve the world's crisis? Or will he turn another leaf and embrace the chaos?
